description: An ancient burial complex beneath the ruined cathedral. The dead have risen, and a dark presence commands them from the lowest chamber.

encounter_waves.name: Restless Bones
encounter_waves.description: Skeletal remains stir to life as you enter the crypt.

encounter_waves.name: The Shambling Dead
encounter_waves.description: A pack of zombies lurches out from behind crumbling sarcophagi.

encounter_waves.name: Ghoul Ambush
encounter_waves.description: Ghouls drop from the ceiling, shrieking with hunger!

encounter_waves.name: The Inner Sanctum
encounter_waves.description: A necromancer acolyte chants over a pile of bones, raising warriors to defend the passage.

encounter_waves.name: The Crypt Guardian
encounter_waves.description: An ancient wraith guards the passage to the Lich King's chamber.

boss.pre_battle_text: The air grows deathly cold. At the heart of the crypt, a robed figure sits upon a throne of bones, a sickly green light pulsing from the phylactery in his skeletal hand.
boss.intro_dialogue: "Ah... more souls for my collection. How thoughtful of you to deliver yourselves."
boss.victory_text: Varekth crumbles to dust. The phylactery shatters, releasing a cascade of freed souls that spiral upward and vanish. The crypt falls silent at last.
